title: The Great Work
intro: Give your machine a few instructions. See what it makes.

help.title: Show me how to build
help.place: Choose an arm, a source, or an output. Then tap a hexagon to place it. Choose a placed part to move, turn, or remove it.
help.tape: Choose an instruction, then a numbered step. The arm follows the steps from left to right. Move a step earlier or later to change the plan.
help.run: Try Step to watch one moment at a time. Run plays your plan. Reset run puts the machine back at its starting position and keeps your design.

words.glyphMeaning: A special tile that changes building blocks when they meet on it.
words.tapeMeaning: The ordered steps that tell one arm what to do.
words.elementMeaning: A building block in this make-believe workshop. Its shape and symbol help you recognize it.

parts.armHint: Reaches one hexagon. Grab a block, turn, then drop it.
parts.dispenserHint: Makes a new block when its hexagon is clear.
parts.acceptorHint: Collects the blocks your machine brings here.

tray.title: Choose a part
tray.help: Tap a part, then a hexagon. You can also drag it onto the board.
tray.dragHelp: Select a part with Enter or Space. Tab to the board, use arrows to choose a hexagon, and press Enter to place it.

glyphHints.simplify: Turns a Fire, Water, Air, or Earth block into Essence.
glyphHints.duplicate: Bring Essence and a Fire, Water, Air, or Earth block together to make a matching pair.
glyphHints.growth: Bring Water and Earth onto the two input spots to make Grass at the output spot.
glyphHints.compression: Bring two matching metal or gem blocks together to move up one rung.
glyphHints.refinement: A Catalyst helps one metal or gem block move up one rung.
glyphHints.affect: Grass with Air makes Life. Grass with Fire makes Death.
glyphHints.realize: Life and Death together make two Balance blocks.
glyphHints.unification: Bring Fire, Water, Air, and Earth together to make Omni.
glyphHints.destroy: Clears a block placed here, making room to try another idea.
glyphHints.bond_single: Joins two neighboring blocks so an arm can carry them together.

instructionHints.GRAB: Pick up the block at the end of the arm.
instructionHints.ROTATE_CW: Turn the arm one hexagon clockwise.
instructionHints.ROTATE_CCW: Turn the arm one hexagon counterclockwise.
instructionHints.WAIT: Stay still for one step while another arm moves.
instructionHints.RESET: Turn back toward the arm’s starting direction. A long return takes more than one step.
instructionHints.REPEAT: Go back to the first instruction. This is how a tape repeats.

timeline.title: Plan the steps
timeline.help: Choose an instruction, then tap a slot. Select a filled slot to change its order or remove it.
timeline.dragHelp: On a filled step, press Space to pick it up, use arrows to move, and Space to drop. Escape cancels. Or select it and use the earlier and later buttons.
timeline.addArm: Place an arm to start its instruction tape.

state.errored: Let’s take a closer look at the parts.
state.finished: Your run is ready to explore.

board.title: Build here
board.fallback: Use a browser with a drawing canvas to explore this board.
board.help: Tap a hexagon to place or select a part. On the keyboard, arrows move the cursor; Home and End reach the other diagonal neighbors. Enter places or selects. Shift + arrows pans the board. Use Zoom and Fit to see more detail.

edit.moveHint: Choose where this part should go.
edit.placeHint: The outlined hexagons show all the space this part needs.
edit.fixed: This part belongs to the example.
edit.partsList: Find a part on my board

context.tools: Open this machine with its original tools to keep all of its steps together.

run.ready: What will your machine make? Try a step and watch the arm.
run.solved: Your machine made the blocks you were going for!
run.wrongProduct: It made {{product}}. You were going for {{target}}, want to see where it changed?
run.mirror: So close, it’s built backwards, like a reflection. Try assembling it the other way round.
run.collision: Two pieces bumped into each other here.
run.stall: It ran, but nothing came out. What could it be missing?
run.limit: Let’s pause and look at the plan. What would you try next?
run.checkParts: Let’s look at the parts and their places before we run.

preview.label: Builder review · #721
preview.confirm: Open this example? Your current unsaved changes will be replaced.
preview.aboutText: This is the local #721 building surface using the draft #720 engine. Changes stay in this session. Saving machines, the full Creator Studio, and the learning-module connection belong to the next tickets.
preview.loadProblem: Let’s try opening the workshop again.

drag.over: Move over the destination, then release.
drag.away: Move back over the board or an instruction slot.
